environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Apache Tomcat 8.5.41 with the OrderProcessingServlet deployed as part of a legacy monolith WAR. The instance is in a public subnet with an Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF, no API gateway in front. The classpath includes commons-collections 3.2.1 (transitive dependency from legacy Hibernate 3.x). JDK 8u181 (no JEP 290 serialization filters). The application is accessed directly via http://<elastic-ip>:8080/orders/process.
